cache_state: fresh serial processes; native object cache disabled; filesystem cache not flushed
interpretation: Kernel compilation, warmup, interpreter numeric references, explicit collection stress, and post-call oracle/aggregate checks are outside kernel CPU timers. Sequence and table kernels keep identity/content guards inside timed loops. Library conversions call loaded misc/sequences closures; native conversions compile the same loops locally. Floating-point comparisons use 1e-10 * (1 + abs(reference)); bigint, sequence, and table checksums are exact. Timed kernels retain ordinary loop accounting.
sampling_order: alternate backend order in successive rounds; no concurrent validation; pair backends by round

statistics_method.limitations: Interval assumes round-pairs are independent and identically distributed on this host; it describes these builds and workloads, not general platform parity.
statistics_method.paired: median LLVM/x64 log-ratio; deterministic percentile bootstrap 95% interval over round-paired log-ratios; 5000 resamples; Park-Miller seed 20261012
statistics_method.per_backend: min, median, max, and median absolute deviation (MAD) over fresh-process rounds

workload_parameters.sequence_collection_stress: checked outside CPU timers; identity/content guards remain inside timed loop
workload_parameters.table_collection_stress: checked outside CPU timers; identity/content guards remain inside timed loop
workload_parameters.table_key_mix: even indexes inserted as string keys; odd indexes inserted as symbols; case-sensitive table
